The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Recorded limitation: The 1962 reading was settled on the facsimile page image; the antecedent reading is an optical text layer only and its letterforms and pointing were not verified on a page image (the 1862's images are not available to this lane, and the Mame's were not rendered for this entry). What was NOT checked: the Benziger conformed printing was used only as a boundary check on the extraction, never as a reading; no attempt was made to establish which of several possible loci in the antecedent is the 'original' one, since an order is not a contribution. This oration is one the Missal draws from a Common; the antecedent witness may print it at the Common, at another saint's day, or at both. That is a difference of position, not of words.

mysterium, Gabrielem Archangelum elegisti: concede propitius; ut, qui festum

caelis: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre in unitate.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Corporis tui et Sanguinis sumptis mysteriis, tuam, Domine Deus noster,
deprecamur clementiam: ut, sicut, Gabriele nuntiante, incarnationem tuam
cognovimus; ita, ipso adjuvante, incarnationis ejusdem beneficia
consequamur: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre in unitate.
